title: Clickable Hero stats modal with 1–1000 list and remove 24/7 stat

requirements.summary: Make the "Years Experience" and "Happy Clients" Hero stats open a closable modal showing a scrollable 1–1000 list.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page Hero section, both the "Years Experience" and "Happy Clients" stat blocks are clickable/tappable.
Clicking either stat opens a modal/dialog without navigating away from the page.
The opened modal shows a visible list of numbers from 1 to 1000 inclusive.
The list is scrollable and does not overflow the viewport on mobile or desktop.
The modal can be closed via an explicit close control and by pressing Escape (if using the existing dialog/modal patterns).
All user-facing text added for this feature is in English.

file_operations.description: Add interactive behavior to the two specified stat blocks: make them keyboard- and pointer-accessible controls that open an in-place modal/dialog. Implement modal state, Escape-to-close handling, body scroll locking while open, and an explicit Close control. Render a scrollable list of numbers 1–1000 within a max-height container to prevent viewport overflow on mobile/desktop, and ensure no navigation occurs.

requirements.summary: Remove the "24/7 Support Available" Hero stat and keep the remaining stats responsive and balanced.
acceptanceCriteria: The Hero section no longer displays "24/7" or "Support Available" anywhere in the stats row/grid.
The stats grid remains responsive across breakpoints (no broken spacing/alignment after removing the third item).

file_operations.description: Remove the third stat block containing "24/7" and "Support Available" and adjust the stats grid classes/layout so the remaining two items are visually balanced and responsive across breakpoints (e.g., update column count/gaps/centering as needed).
